name: Andy Schwartz
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 23, 2015–2022; Teton County Commission, 2000–2012
background: Andy Schwartz of Jackson served in the Wyoming House from 2015 to 2022, representing House District 23. The 2021–22 legislative directory listed him as a small-business owner, said he was born Sept. 26, 1950, in Washington, D.C., and recorded a B.A. in history from Oberlin College. It also listed service as a Teton County commissioner from 2000 to 2012, and said he was married to his wife, Jean, and had two children.
